name: pre_market_auction_edge_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: NIFTY's NSE pre-opening session (09:00–09:08) produces an indicative equilibrium price that reflects net overnight FII and institutional futures positioning. When NIFTY opens with a gap exceeding 0.2% from the previous close, the auction price has embedded a strong directional bias. If the first 2 minutes of continuous trading (09:15–09:17) confirm the gap direction — meaning institutional order flow is absorbing supply at the gap level rather than fading it — algo momentum strategies and options market makers delta-hedging their books amplify the move over the next 30–90 seconds. At 5-second resolution we can detect this 2-minute confirmation the moment it completes and enter before the burst has fully played out, capturing the continuation leg as remaining institutional TWAP/VWAP orders execute.

indicators.name: opening_gap_pct
indicators.purpose: Proxy for the NSE pre-opening auction equilibrium gap. Lookback is 1 day because the signal resets each session — we compare the current day's opening price (which reflects the pre-opening auction outcome) to the prior day's final close. No intraday rolling window required; this is a daily snapshot signal carried forward across the early session bars.

indicators.name: intraday_ret
indicators.purpose: 2-minute cumulative return since the day's first bar open — the directional confirmation signal. Lookback of 24 bars = 2 minutes at 5s, chosen to match our confirmation window: 2 minutes is sufficient to distinguish institutional absorption (gap holds) from gap-fade (gap reverses). The original used 5 one-minute bars (5 minutes); we compress to 2 minutes because we are trading the fast burst leg, not the sustained intraday trend. A 2-minute confirmation at 5-second resolution is granular enough to detect the direction of institutional order flow without waiting for gap information to fully dissipate.

indicators.name: bar_in_day
indicators.formula: per-bar index within trading day, reset at each day's first bar
indicators.purpose: Gates entries to bars 24–72 within the day (09:17–09:21 IST). After bar 72 (~6 min from open), the opening gap information has been absorbed and the directional edge from the pre-auction signal decays. This prevents stale signals from firing mid-session.

conditions: bar_in_day in [24, 72] — 09:17 to 09:21 IST entry window
buy_ce.confirmation: gap-up confirmed by bullish 2-min early session return

buy_pe.confirmation: gap-down confirmed by bearish 2-min early session return

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts (~8 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5): a confirmed gap that reverses by 8 spot points within 60 seconds means institutional absorption has failed and a gap fade is underway — the original thesis is invalidated. NIFTY's early session 30-second range is typically 5–12 pts, so 8 pts is tight enough to cut quickly but not so tight it triggers on normal volatility.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option pts (~14 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5): confirmed opening gap continuations on NIFTY typically deliver a 15–25 spot point burst in the first 60–90 seconds as momentum algos pile on. Targeting 7 pts captures ~50% of the median expected burst leg, giving a 1:1.75 R:R. Setting a higher target risks holding through the post-burst stall where the gap move decelerates.
exit.eod_rule: flatten at 15:25 IST; entry window practically closes at 09:21 IST (bar_in_day > 72 filter)

filters.vix_filter: none — opening gap is a pre-market signal; intraday VIX level not relevant at session open
filters.time_filter: entries restricted to 09:17–09:21 IST (bar_in_day 24–72); stale gap signal beyond 09:21
filters.volume_filter: none — NIFTY index volume is reliable at open; individual stock auction volume not required
filters.trend_filter: opening_gap_pct direction must align with intraday_ret direction (both conditions required)
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution, no bid-ask spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — as pre-market gap-and-go strategies become more crowded on NIFTY futures, the early-session burst window may compress further; the gap threshold may need tightening over time

adaptation_notes: Original strategy used NSE pre-opening auction equilibrium price (AEP, 09:00–09:08) for individual Nifty50 stocks — top 20 by turnover with >500 pre-market orders — holding 15–75 minutes on 1-min bars. Converted to NIFTY index using: (1) first bar open vs prev-day close as AEP proxy — equivalent because the pre-opening session's outcome is embedded in the NIFTY opening price; (2) 2-minute (24-bar at 5s) confirmation window replacing 5 one-minute bars — compressed because we trade the fast burst not the sustained trend; (3) hold time compressed from 15–75 min to 15–120 seconds — we capture only the momentum burst leg, not the full intraday continuation; (4) individual stocks replaced by NIFTY index — cleaner signal with no stock-specific event risk. The stock-specific pre-market AEP data requirement is eliminated by using index-level opening gap, which is fully derivable from the OHLCV pipeline.
weaknesses: First-bar open gap is a noisier AEP proxy than true pre-opening auction price — NSE pre-opening session can set indicative prices that diverge from the actual first-trade price
Only 0–2 signals per day with gap threshold 0.2% — flat-open days generate no trades; low throughput requires high per-trade win rate
Early NIFTY session (09:15–09:20) has higher volatility and occasionally erratic moves; gap confirmation filter reduces but does not eliminate false bursts
Gap threshold of 0.2% is large enough that signals are rare; index option premium must move at least 4 pts to hit stop, which is achievable within 30 seconds
